device_modal.title: Device Details
device_modal.usage_realtime_counters_hint: Real-time data estimated from eero hardware counters
device_modal.usage_info_p1_desc: The dashboard reads physical Wi-Fi hardware packet counters directly from the mesh nodes and continuously estimates transfer volumes every 30 seconds.
device_modal.usage_info_p2_title: Why can counters jump or reset?
device_modal.usage_info_p2_desc: Packet counters live in volatile memory on the eero node radio. If a device sleeps, disconnects, or roams between mesh nodes, the radio resets its counter to zero.
device_modal.usage_info_p3_title: Why do you see fewer GB than downloaded?
device_modal.usage_info_p3_desc: Internet downloads (e.g. game launchers, installers, streaming) use compression over the wire. A game taking 2.5 GB on disk often transfers only 1.3 - 1.7 GB over the network.
device_modal.usage_info_p4_desc: Wired devices pass through the eero's Layer 2 hardware switch. Unlike Wi-Fi radios, eero hardware does not expose real-time streaming packet counters for Ethernet ports, even with eero Plus (the official eero mobile app calculates historical aggregates on Amazon AWS servers).
device_modal.usage_info_p5_desc: The main table displays the Cumulative Total since last connection, while this modal shows only the Delta transferred within the selected time window (e.g. Last 24h).
